description: Rounded chat input bar: auto-growing textarea plus voice/send. A pill on one line, rounded-rect once it grows; the mic swaps to a brand-filled send as soon as there is text. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a newline. The consumer positions it. Copy: the placeholder is an invitation, not an instruction manual: one short line naming what this assistant can be asked. It disappears the moment anyone types, so nothing a reader needs may live only there.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (optional — composer manages its own state otherwise).

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text on submit.

props.name: streaming
props.description: Assistant is responding — swaps send for a stop button.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the stop button is pressed.

props.name: aiSpark
props.description: Decorative AI spark at the inline start — marks the bar as AI-powered.
